mapper.select: SELECT FROM benefit_definition WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND benefit_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}

SELECT FROM benefit_definition d WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{store} AND benefit_id>#{after} AND version=(SELECT MAX(d2.version) FROM benefit_definition d2 WHERE d2.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND d2.benefit_id=d.benefit_id) ORDER BY benefit_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE benefit_definition SET reserved=reserved+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND benefit_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND reserved+issued<quota
UPDATE benefit_definition SET reserved=reserved-1,issued=issued+10 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND benefit_id=#{grant.benefitId} AND version=#{grant.benefitVersion} AND reserved>0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM benefit_grant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} AND source_type='ORDER' FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM benefit_grant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND grant_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM benefit_grant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND grant_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM benefit_grant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND grant_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE benefit_grant SET status=#{status.code},remaining_units=#{remaining},debt_units=#{debt},expires_at=#{expires},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND grant_id=#{grant.grantId} AND version=#{grant.version}

UPDATE benefit_grant SET remaining_units=remaining_units-#{units},status=IF(remaining_units=0,'CONSUMED','AVAILABLE'),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND grant_id=#{grant.grantId} AND version=#{grant.version} AND status='AVAILABLE' AND remaining_units>=#{units} AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM benefit_grant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND grant_id>#{after} ORDER BY grant_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT entry_id,action,units,balance,reference,created_at FROM benefit_ledger WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND grant_id=#{grant} AND entry_id>#{after} ORDER BY entry_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM benefit_grant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND source_type=#{type} AND source_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
